m7-parity.title: M7 closing bar: bit-identical tokens and session snapshots across the Rust library, uor-chat CLI and browser worker
m7-parity.grader: bit-identity comparator: generated tokens compared as exact u32 ids and session snapshots compared byte-for-byte (UR4SESS1 byte stream, SHA-256 digests) across the three hosts; implemented by crates/uor-r4-integer/tests/m7_parity_library_cli_browser.rs (library and CLI legs) and web/studio/verify_m7_parity.mjs (browser worker leg), with 3 tamper controls (#3008)
m7-parity.source: issue #2867 comment 6352825431 (revised bar-registration request, superseding 6352106589); harness merged as #3008 (3aee6353c); preregistration draft docs/labs/m7-parity-library-cli-browser/preregistration-DRAFT-2026-10-22.md; PM registration by kimi-12
m7-parity.noise: none - bit-identity equality is exact, so the bar carries no noise band (the CHARTER section 4.4 count-table spread applies to scored panels, not to a deterministic equality check)
m7-parity.seeds: not applicable - deterministic protocol on one pinned artifact; the synthetic stand-in is mk-synthetic-stack seed 5 (UORLUT01, 469252 B, sha256:d60f88d6e08ac60763b35484307f9425f702b9fead4615dd8cbe5fdbbced92df, vocabulary 40, read_mode lorentz) until an accepted M4 UORLUT01 artifact (#2857) substitutes

bars.label: bit-identical tokens and UR4SESS1 snapshots across the Rust library, uor-chat CLI and browser worker: 48 tokens per prompt (384 total) plus a fresh-process 32+16 save/restore split requiring tokens_32_plus_16 == tokens_48 and snapshot_48_restored == snapshot_48 byte-for-byte on every leg; greedy integer argmax at temperature 0 (lowest token id on ties); lorentz read mode; no softmax, no matmul, no floating-point sampling
bars.note: current is 0/8 on the milestone bar because no accepted M4 UORLUT01 artifact exists yet. On the pinned synthetic stand-in the harness passes 8/8 prompts, 384/384 tokens, 16/16 UR4SESS1 snapshots and 3/3 tamper controls (#3008 record); per the item's Done-when that validates the harness and is not a milestone result. Re-execute the identical protocol on the accepted artifact for the bar to count.

m7-parity.note: Registers the measurement protocol for the M7 closing bar set by issue #2035 (bit-identical tokens and snapshots across the three hosts); the milestone bar itself is unchanged. Frozen at PM registration (#2867 comment 6352825431) so the synthetic stand-in check and the future accepted-artifact run use one identical protocol. Strictly zero softmax/squashing (CHARTER section 3.2 / D23), zero matmul/GEMM (section 3.3 / D25), zero floating-point sampling; host controls are finite and deterministic.
